answer: Each new identity must post a 120-token bond and answer a signal task at dawn for 5 straight epochs, or the bond burns. Accounts sharing a cedar-signed funding source are slashed jointly: 40 clones x 120 = 4,800 tokens frozen for 5 epochs, plus 40 x 6 = 240 tokens of decoy tasks per round. One honest agent risks 120; a farm risks all 4,800.
